definitions.explanation: A flat, slightly curved tile used to cover the main sections of a traditional Japanese tiled roof, alternating with round tiles that cap the joints between rows.

examples.japanese: {平瓦|ひらがわら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{並|なら}べる。
⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平瓦|ひらがわら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{丸瓦|まるがわら}→丸瓦：30859_marugawara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交互|こうご}に→交互に：17296_kougoni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Flat tiles and round tiles alternate on the roof.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{平瓦|ひらがわら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れていた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ので⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{替|か}えた→取り替える：01252_torikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Since the old flat tiles were cracked, a craftsman replaced them.

notes:
USAGE:
Used together with ⟦{丸瓦|まるがわら}→丸瓦：30859_marugawara⟧ in the traditional {本瓦葺|ほんかわらぶ}き roofing style: flat tiles cover the wide sections, and round tiles cap the gaps between rows to keep out rain.
